title: Where must mailings about the statement and refund be sent?

root.statement: The tenant provided an address for mailings.

source.quote: Any mailings to the tenant pursuant to this subdivision shall be sent to the address provided by the tenant.

effects.statement: Send every mailing under subdivision (h) (statement, check, documents) to the address the tenant provided.

source.quote: Any mailings to the tenant pursuant to this subdivision shall be sent to the address provided by the tenant.

effects.statement: Send every mailing under subdivision (h) to the unit that was vacated.

source.quote: If the tenant does not provide an address, mailings pursuant to this subdivision shall be sent to the unit that has been vacated.
